examples.description: Change a quote line's price, made against the line as last read

failure_modes.recovery: Call quote_item_list or quote_list to find the id.
failure_modes.when: the id (or a new quote_id) does not name a row in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Send the price in integer CENTS, 0 or more ($15.00 → 1500) and a discount as discount_bps; split a larger amount across lines.
failure_modes.when: the edited line would have a negative price, a quantity outside 0.001..1,000,000 or with more than 3 decimals, a discount_bps outside 0..10000, or a total above 10,000,000,000 cents

failure_modes.recovery: Resend with expected_updated_at set to the line's updated_at from your read (the refusal names the current value; invoice_item_read or quote_item_read shows the line).
failure_modes.when: expected_updated_at is missing: every line edit or removal carries the updated_at of the line it was made against

failure_modes.recovery: Send whole-number lines without unit or discount_bps for now; the owner runs `pnpm db:seed` to enable them.
failure_modes.when: the line has a fractional quantity, a unit or a discount and the platform catalog does not list those line fields yet

failure_modes.recovery: Send a tax_code the error lists (the codes that apply on the document's issue date), or leave tax_code out on a document without a scheme.
failure_modes.when: tax_code is on a line of a document without a tax_scheme, is not a code of the document's scheme or does not apply on its issue date, or is missing on a new line of a my_sst document

failure_modes.recovery: Read the quote's converted_invoice_id and change that invoice's lines instead (invoice_item_create, invoice_item_update); issue a new quote for new work.
failure_modes.when: the quote (or the quote a line is moved to) is converted: its invoice was copied from its lines, so they no longer change (already_converted: true)

failure_modes.recovery: Call quote_item_read to see the current line, then retry against it; nothing was written.
failure_modes.when: another edit changed this line while this edit ran, or expected_updated_at did not match

description: Edits a quote line's description, quantity, unit, price or discount, or moves it to another quote. expected_updated_at is required: the line's updated_at from your read; without it nothing is written and the refusal names the current value; a line changed since then answers CONFLICT. Refuses a line of a converted quote or a move onto one (CONFLICT: change its invoice instead). Bounds: unit_price_cents is integer CENTS, 0 or more; quantity 0.001 to 1,000,000 (3 decimals); discount_bps 0 to 10000; quantity × unit_price_cents at most 10,000,000,000. unit "" clears the unit. tax_code is the line's code under the document's tax_scheme, refused on a document without a scheme. NEXT: quote_read.

discount_bps.description: Optional line discount in basis points: 10% → 1000, none → 0. A discount is never a lower or negative price.

expected_updated_at.description: Required: the line's updated_at from your last read (quote_item_read, quote_item_list or the create answer). Left out, the call is refused and names the current value; a line changed since then returns CONFLICT with the current value and stays as it is.

quantity.description: How many, up to 3 decimals (1.5 hours → 1.5). A new line defaults to 1.

name: quote_item_update
